prompts.name: scenePrompt1
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game environment background, landscape 16:9, 1920x1080. Create one polished cozy room environment for an existing animal polyomino puzzle game. STYLE REFERENCE: the supplied local reference images are style only: creamy flat watercolor filled animals, slightly imperfect warm cocoa-brown pencil outlines, restrained paper grain, minimal soft shadows, cute rounded forms. Match that gentle hand-drawn picture-book aesthetic, NOT 3D, NOT pixel art.
SCENE: "Window-side afternoon nap". A warm ivory and pale peach sunroom, an open sage-green casement window with flowing oatmeal curtains on the upper left, tiny view of powder-blue sky and clouds, potted eucalyptus on sill; a low shelf, little books, ceramic cup, a basket and folded blanket near outer corners. Muted dusty rose, buttercream, desaturated sage, warm honey wood. Floor takes lower 75% of frame and is mostly flat near-top-down (parallel horizontal lines, NO converging perspective), upper wall a shallow band. Cozy sun patches, tiny leaf shadows on periphery.
LAYOUT CRITICAL: This is a game background behind real movable animals and a separate board. Keep exact middle 36% width and middle 54% height almost EMPTY even cream floor, visually calm. Keep both side regions (left 5%-30%, right 70%-95%, y25%-80%) very quiet too for the animals. Put furniture and detailed objects only near the top 20% and bottom corners. No board, no grid, no rug in middle, no animal, no people, no UI, no lettering, no watermarks, no dark patches. Flat delicate warm brown outlines, sparse detail, low saturation, plenty of generous empty floor. Full bleed opaque landscape illustration.

prompts.name: scenePrompt2
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production 2D game background, full bleed 16:9 landscape illustration 1920x1080. Theme: "Mint courtyard". A peaceful tiny enclosed cottage garden for a cozy animal polyomino game. Match creamy watercolor fills and warm soft cocoa pencil outlines of supplied animal style references. Flat rounded forms, delicate paper grain, low saturation macaron colors: sage/mint, dusty blush flowers, warm ivory, powder blue. Mostly pale mint lawn or stone patio viewed near-top-down, parallel horizontal direction, NO isometric perspective. Only at top 20%: low cream picket fence, rounded shrubs, a peach garden gate, soft distant flowering tree. Small watering can and terracotta pots at outer bottom corners. Barely visible leaf shadows. Keep exact central 36% width x54% height entirely clear and even, for a separate 3x3 gameplay board. Keep left5%-30% and right70%-95%, y25%-80% very sparse, for large movable animals. Peripheral decor only. Cute storybook charm, simpler shapes and less detail than a detailed watercolor painting. NO central board, NO grid, NO pond in center (pond tile added separately), no animals, people, text, logo, UI, dark patches. Quiet open environment with very generous empty central and side areas.

prompts.name: scenePrompt3
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished 2D game environment background, 16:9 landscape 1920x1080. "Peach and sage glasshouse". Same visual family as the supplied creamy hand-drawn cat: soft watercolor fill, simple plump rounded forms, warm cocoa pencil outlines, gently imperfect edges, sparse paper grain, low saturation macaron palette. A calm miniature conservatory with powder-blue glass windowpanes and sage-green window mullions confined to the upper 20% of frame, trailing green leaves, hanging terracotta pots, peach flowering vines, pale lilac hydrangeas at the far corners. Lower 75% of image mostly open warm pale cream limestone terrace seen near top-down, parallel tile courses, NO converging perspective, NO isometric scene. Far bottom corners: a small potting stool, watering jug and closed seed packets without text. Central 36% width and central 54% height must be completely quiet even floor for a separately rendered puzzle grid; left5%-30% and right70%-95% across y25%-80% also calm to leave room for large movable animal pieces. Avoid furniture through the middle. A few muted sun flecks only near edges. Pale apricot, ivory, sage, dusty pink, misty blue. Cozy storybook drawing, not photorealism, not 3D. No board, grid, central pool or central flowers, no animals, people, text, UI, logos, black. Full bleed opaque background.

prompts.name: tilePrompt
prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production sprite atlas, exactly 3 columns by 2 rows, 1536x1024 pixels, six equal 512x512 cells. Genuine transparent background. Each individual graphic centered precisely in its cell, no graphics cross cell boundaries. No text, numbers, captions, divider lines or drop shadows beyond each graphic. Match the supplied animal art: creamy watercolor fills, simple chunky rounded shapes, soft warm cocoa pencil outlines, gentle imperfect hand drawn edges, LOW SATURATION MACARON.
TOP ROW floor tiles, same square geometry, outer graphic fills 94% of each 512x512 cell with small rounded corners, each graphic dead square and seen exactly from ABOVE, no perspective or side faces:
top left: pale buttercream quilted cotton floor cushion square, warm beige outline, very subtle stitched inner seam near edge, almost plain center.
top middle: pale mint/sage garden stepping-stone square, thin warm taupe outline, almost plain softly mottled center.
top right: pale peach/ivory terracotta terrace square, thin dusty rose outline, almost plain center.
BOTTOM ROW fixed obstacles, square footprints, whole graphic stays INSIDE center 90% of cell:
bottom left: a small rounded square terracotta planter seen exactly from ABOVE, pale sage eucalyptus leaves and 3 tiny cream daisies, pot rim clearly enclosing the plant, compact and cute, not sprawling.
bottom middle: a rounded square pale powder-blue water pool seen exactly from ABOVE, warm cream stone rim, two simple ivory curved ripples, a tiny sage lily pad in one corner; blue water dominates, square not circle.
bottom right: a rounded square raised flowerbed seen exactly from ABOVE, pale peach rim, muted sage leaves with little dusty blush and butter-yellow flowers, clear compact planted bed.
All six have related soft brown outlines; floors intentionally plain and light, obstacles distinctly more detailed and solid, readability at small scale. Flat 2D sprite production atlas. Avoid shiny 3D, perspective, black outlines, strong shadows, saturated colors.
